notes.grounding: Claims match the script: unconditional exit 0 at the tail, exit 1 error paths, trailing exit-code comment block, section numbers 6/7/8, OVERALL_PERCENTAGE global, bc guard. notes.verification: Every task has a Verify clause and the matrix includes off-by-one (min 1 exits 3, min 0 exits 0 on a 0% fixture, min 100 exits 0 on a 100% fixture). Weak spots: T004 'is accepted' is not an observable output, T008 lists outcomes without commands, stderr-unchanged claim is never diffed, T003 baseline.txt is never used.

notes.consistency: Ids, path, exit codes and fixture agree across the three docs. T007 expects MIN_PERCENT hits only in show_help, the option loop and the tail, but T004 and plan.md add a MIN_PERCENT global, which lives in the GLOBALS section. T003 is marked [P] but depends on T002's fixture.
notes.clarity: Implementable without questions in folder mode. Under --file the tail needs the file percentage, which is local inside output_text/output_json; the packet does not say how the tail gets it, nor what exit applies when the --file target does not exist.
